notes: Title aligned as ordinary source text; the article on מַעֲלוֹת is unrepresented because the ASV writes 'A Song of Ascents' with no 'the' anywhere in the chain, and the supplied 'A' is the construct noun's under rule 15.
'unto the house' stays on the bare construct noun as an accusative of direction under rule 33; 'go' is intransitive, so rule 44's valency clause does not reach the word.
בְּ before the participial clause takes 'when' as a present function morpheme (rules 11, 52); the participle takes 'they said' with its supplied subject pronoun.
